items.stem: Predictability across the ART has fallen for two consecutive PIs. Which forum is designed to identify and solve the systemic causes?

options.text: The Inspect & Adapt event, including the problem-solving workshop
options.rationale: Correct: I&A includes a structured problem-solving workshop to address systemic issues and improve the ART.

options.text: The daily stand-up of a single team
options.rationale: A single team's stand-up cannot address ART-wide systemic causes.
An email thread is not the structured improvement mechanism SAFe defines.
PI Planning plans work; the I&A event is where improvement actions are generated.

items.explanation: Correct: I&A includes a structured problem-solving workshop to address systemic issues and improve the ART.

items.stem: What is the main purpose of the ART sync (e.g., Coach Sync and PO Sync) facilitated by the RTE?

options.text: To track progress toward PI objectives and surface impediments and dependencies
options.rationale: Correct: ART sync keeps the train aligned by tracking progress and raising issues across teams.

options.text: To assign individual tasks to developers
options.rationale: Task assignment is a team self-organization matter, not the ART sync purpose.
ART sync complements, not replaces, PI Planning.
Administrative approvals are not an ART sync function.

items.stem: Which TWO are responsibilities of the RTE when preparing for PI Planning? (Select TWO)

options.text: Ensuring readiness of scope, context and facilities for the event
options.rationale: Correct: the RTE drives event readiness including content, logistics and alignment.

options.text: Aligning stakeholders on the planning scope and business context
options.rationale: Correct: establishing shared context and alignment is a key RTE preparation task.

options.text: Writing every team's detailed iteration plans in advance
options.rationale: Teams plan their own iterations during PI Planning; the RTE does not pre-write them.
Compensation is not an RTE responsibility.
Pricing is a product management/portfolio concern, not an RTE task.
